description: This file defines a JavaScript module for managing SugarCharts within the SuiteCRM platform, including functions to load and add charts to an internal array, with licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: loadSugarCharts
methods.description: Loads and renders charts for a specified active tab, then clears the charts array.

methods.name: addToChartsArrayJson
methods.description: Adds multiple charts from a JSON object to the internal charts array for a specific tab.

methods.name: addToChartsArray
methods.description: Adds a single chart's details to the internal charts array for a specific tab.
